source.grade_max: p99 of max 30 m sub-span grade, real ground edges, US train tiles (3DEP)
source.bridge_span_max: p99 of real bridge runs over rivers, train tiles (pooled to more minor classes if < 10)
source.bridge_angle_min_deg: p5 of real crossing angles over rivers, train tiles
source.lake_span_max: p99 of real bridges over lakes / sea if >= 10, else default 30 m
source.viaduct_clearance_min: engineering assumption (10 m): no valley-spanning bridge in the data
source.viaduct_span_max: p99 of real dry bridge runs (overpasses), train tiles
